verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Ollama has a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints, and Python/JavaScript libraries. None of these items mention streaming tokens as they are generated, and a general API or client library does not show incremental token delivery. The serving-API axis clearly applies to Ollama, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream generated tokens back to my application as they are produced
